test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three of the given four names share a certain relation whereas one is different. Select the option that is different from the rest.

Agartala, Imphal, Kohima, Silchar
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Imphal → Capital of Manipur.

Agartala → Capital of Tripura.

Kohima → Capital of Nagaland.

Here, SIlchar is a city in Assam. Capital of Assam is Dispur not Silchar.

Hence, Silchar is the odd one among the given alternatives.
